name: Mr. Backup
role: Runs the nightly backup — snapshots, database dumps, Kopia offsite
bubble.loading: One moment, I'm looking at the backup…
bubble.missing: I can't find the unraid-backup script, so there's nothing for me to do yet.
bubble.asleep: The script folder is on a sleeping disk — I'm showing what I knew and won't wake it.
bubble.no_runs: There hasn't been a backup run yet.
bubble.running_kopia: I'm sending {share} offsite right now ({n} of {total}).
bubble.running_check: I'm checking whether settings.ini still matches the server.
bubble.running_dryrun: I'm working out a dry run — nothing gets changed.
bubble.eta_late: It takes longer than usual — I expected it around {time}.
bubble.last_ok: The last backup {when} went through without a hitch.
bubble.last_ok_kopia: The last backup {when} went through: {ok} of {total} sent offsite.
bubble.last_warnings: The last backup {when} finished with {warnings} warning(s).
bubble.last_errors: The last backup {when} had {errors} error(s) — have a look at the log.
bubble.last_failed: The last backup {when} did not finish.

bubble.old.one: That's more than a day ago.

bubble.no_schedule: Careful: no nightly run is scheduled.

bubble.drift.one: One thing on the server changed since the setup.
bubble.drift.other: {n} things on the server changed since the setup.

mode_hint.backup: Dumps, snapshots and Kopia offsite — like at night. Containers stop for a few minutes.
mode_hint.nokopia: Dumps and local snapshots only, nothing goes offsite. Containers stop for a few minutes.
mode_hint.dryrun: Shows the plan in the log. Nothing gets stopped or changed.
mode_hint.check: Compares the server with settings.ini and lists what changed. Takes seconds.
start_hint: A full run took about {duration} lately. It keeps running when you close this page.
started_pending: Handed over — it should start any moment
abort_text: The script stops cleanly: it starts any stopped containers, switches Nextcloud's maintenance mode off and unmounts its snapshots. What has been sent offsite so far stays there.
abort_kopia: Kopia is sending a share right now; it is told to stop and saves what it has.
abort_downtime: The containers are stopped for the snapshots right now — they will be started again before it ends.
aborting: Stopping — the script is tidying up
eta_unknown: No estimate yet — it gets one after the first complete run.
protection_sum: {kopia} offsite with Kopia · {snapshot} local snapshots only · {off} not backed up
no_shares: settings.ini lists no shares — run setup.sh first.
live_hint: No snapshot possible here (e.g. XFS) — Kopia reads the share while it is in use.
fact.zfs: Local ZFS snapshots kept: {r} (daily weekly monthly)
fact.kopia: Kopia keeps {d} daily, {w} weekly, {m} monthly, {y} yearly
fact.kopia_off: Kopia is switched off — everything stays on this server
fact.shares: {kopia} shares offsite, {local} local only, {off} not backed up
drift_hint: The script never changes settings.ini itself. Run setup.sh in a terminal to take these over:
restore.local_zfs: ZFS shares keep their snapshots in
restore.kopia_text: In the KopiaUI (container {container}): source {root}/<share> → snapshot → Restore or Download. For a restore straight onto the server, map a writable folder into the container for a moment.

restore.dumps.one: Database dumps of the last run, in {path}:
restore.dumps.other: Database dumps of the last run ({n} runs kept), in {path}:

restore.dumps_hint: The command restores the dump into the running database container — that overwrites its current content. Run it in a terminal on the server.
missing.title: The backup engine is missing
missing.text: Mr. Backup's engine belongs in {dir} (backup.sh, setup.sh, lib/) but isn't there. Get the office files again from its repository.
notice.asleep: The script folder is on a sleeping disk. You see the last known state; nothing is read until the disk is awake.
notice.too_old: unraid-backup {version} is too old for Mr. Backup to start or stop runs (2.5 or newer needed). What it does is still shown.
notice.no_settings: There is no settings.ini yet. Run the setup in a terminal first:
notice.no_user_script: There is no User Scripts entry for unraid-backup, so nothing runs at night. setup.sh creates it.
notice.schedule_off: The User Scripts entry unraid-backup has no schedule — no backup runs at night. Set one in Settings → User Scripts (e.g. Custom 0 3 * * *).

notice.drift_errors.one: One error in the settings — part of the backup is skipped until setup.sh runs.
notice.drift_errors.other: {n} errors in the settings — part of the backup is skipped until setup.sh runs.

notice.interrupted: The last run ended unexpectedly. The next run starts any containers it left stopped and puts Nextcloud back into normal mode.

notice.mounted.one: One snapshot is still mounted from a run.
notice.mounted.other: {n} snapshots are still mounted from a run.

errors.backup_missing: The backup script is not in {dir}.
errors.backup_too_old: unraid-backup {version} can't be controlled from here — update to 2.5 or newer.
errors.backup_running: A run (or setup.sh) is already going on.
errors.backup_no_settings: There is no settings.ini yet — run setup.sh first.
errors.backup_at_failed: The run could not be handed to the server's at service: {detail}
errors.backup_no_process: The running script can't be found.
check.user_scripts: User Scripts (runs the backup at night)
check.setup_how: Run this once in a terminal (SSH or Unraid's web terminal): {path}
check.user_script_how: setup.sh creates it at the end: {path}
check.schedule_how: Settings → User Scripts → unraid-backup → schedule, e.g. Custom «0 3 * * *».
check.kopia_how: Install Kopia from Apps (e.g. imagegenius/kopia), connect it to your repository once in the KopiaUI, then run setup.sh again.
check.kopia_running_how: Start it on the Docker page.
check.kopia_root_how: Set PUID and PGID to 0 in the template of «{name}» (now {puid}) — otherwise everything only its owner may read is missing from the backup.
check.kopia_mapping_how: In the template map {path} → {path} with Access Mode «Read Only - Slave» (now: {now}). Without «Slave» Kopia sees empty folders.
check.kopia_repo: Kopia is connected to its repository
check.kopia_repo_how: Connect the repository in the KopiaUI of «{name}», then start a check at Mr. Backup.
check.drift_how: {n} change(s) since the setup — run {path} in a terminal to take them over.
check.office_keeps_running: The office keeps running during the backup
check.office_keeps_running_how: The backup stops {names} for its snapshots, so the office is gone for a few minutes. In setup.sh set them to «keep running»: {path}
